visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a macro close-up of a well-manicured human finger resting against a clean, brightly lit white background. The fingernail is coated in a smooth, glossy pink polish. A pair of silver metal precision tweezers, held by an out-of-frame hand, presses into the edge of the polish near the cuticle. (2) As the tweezers lift, the pink polish is revealed to be a flexible film that peels away from the nail in a single, continuous piece. The natural nail underneath appears clean and undamaged. Large black text overlays provide a title and benefit description at the top. (3) The scene cuts to a nail coated in solid forest-green polish. The tweezers grip the side of the green film and pull it off smoothly, demonstrating that no liquid remover is required. The lighting remains bright and even, characteristic of a professional studio environment. (4) The next phase features a nail with shimmering, metallic rose-gold polish. The tweezers lift the edge of the reflective film, peeling it upward in a satisfying motion. The background remains a consistent, minimalist white surface. (5) A final cut shows a finger with soft peach-pink polish. The tweezers repeat the peeling action, showcasing the product's consistent performance across different colors and textures. Throughout the video, only the finger and the tweezers are visible, focusing entirely on the product demonstration.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins immediately with an upbeat, studio-quality acoustic-pop track featuring a steady mid-tempo drum beat (~115 BPM) and bright acoustic guitar strums. A male vocalist with a clear, cheerful tenor sings in English in a major key. There are no spoken dialogues or voiceovers. (2) As the tweezers touch the nail surface, a very faint, high-frequency incidental noise of metal contact is audible. The BGM remains the primary signal, maintaining a high Signal-To-Noise ratio. (3) The pop track continues with consistent rhythm and energy. The vocal melody is friendly and melodic, with no shifts in tempo or arousal. Subdued rustling sounds of the polish film being lifted are buried under the music track. (4) The final segment of the audio track repeats the rhythmic musical pattern with the male singer's voice remaining stable and pleasant. The production is clean with no digital distortion, providing a professional and energetic backdrop to the visual demonstration.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Hook -> Demonstration 1 -> Demonstration 2 -> Demonstration 3 -> Demonstration 4.
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video aims to highlight the functional convenience of water-based nail polish by demonstrating its easy removal. By showing multiple colors being peeled off in one piece without liquid remover, it positions the product as a fast and hassle-free beauty solution for consumers.
